findings.title: Artifact manifest self-referential builder-report size is stale/incorrect
findings.invariant: Artifact manifest and frozen builder report describe the same file; manifest self-entry size should match actual builder report size
findings.reproduction: Manifest R9_BUILDER_REPORT.json entry says size=8076; actual frozen file is 8195 bytes. The manifest audit contract requires 77 real entries and excludes the self-referential entry, and committing that 8076 value at freeze time does not alter the 77-entry checks.

findings.title: Mirror-run static gate is not clean when copied outside the repo root
findings.invariant: A copied R9 gate tree fired at its own REPO_ROOT should pass the mandatory ruff subgates
findings.reproduction: After copying scripts/remaster/r9, tests/remaster/r9, src/jarvis_foundry/capabilities_live, evidence, and the work package to an isolated mirror temp and patching only common.py (EVIDENCE_DIR + JARVIS_R9_TEMP + REPO_ROOT), ruff check/format and mypy failed because ruff treated frozen files as unformatted/un-sorted imports. The exact same files pass from the real worktree, so this is a mirror-harness artifact and not a source regression.

findings.title: Synthetic seed credential literals are embedded in R9 script source
findings.invariant: No secret VALUE should appear in R9-owned source under a broad exact-value interpretation
findings.reproduction: canary_runner.py intentionally contains synthetic local canary/token seed values, including the three builder manifest secrets. The builder's own secret-scan only learns the 3 manifest values yet still reports a clean scan; the artifact exact-value scan found 0 leaks in evidence. These are synthetic local test seeds, not real secrets, and no occurrence exists in evidence/downloadable artifacts.

findings.title: Live guard comparison relies on a narrow mirror window for process equality
findings.invariant: Protected state/process equality should hold in the recorded window without masking attributable mutation
findings.reproduction: The mirror window ran live guard before/after around canary/verification/focused gates and reported protected_state_unchanged=True, r9_attributable_mutation=False. The prior builder finding R9-V-003 already documented live daemon worker churn between wide windows; this fresh window used the narrow gate window and remained clean.

findings.title: Canary service health proves capability on localhost only
findings.invariant: Provider receipt should remain truthful about the tested provider boundary
findings.reproduction: The services adapter's /health response is produced by the local ephemeral service and serves as the system receipt; network access remains disabled and external providers remain BLOCKED/NOT_TESTED. This is a real local canary effect, not an external provider claim.
